name: Hui zhuan ping an ye
source:
Yui Umino is invited by renowned metuber Yuu Kasumi to join the Midnight Radio channel. Her first assignment: filming the devastated Haiming Hotel.

[From [url=https://sagisawayukiho.itch.io/merrybadnight]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
知名Metuber早霧結優邀請羽海野繪唯加入「深夜電臺」頻道。她接到的第一樁任務，是拍攝已成廢墟的飯店海明館。

［摘自[url=https://sagisawayukiho.itch.io/merrybadnight]itch.io[/url]］
